bank.name: Provinces & Regions
bank.subject: Pakistan Affairs
bank.description: Capitals, valleys, cities and notable places across Pakistan's provinces and territories.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Punjab?
questions.explanation: Lahore is the capital of Punjab and Pakistan's cultural heart.

questions.explanation: Karachi is the capital of Sindh province.

questions.explanation: Peshawar is the capital of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
